security_audit.summary: The review confirms filesystem write risks in the bundled scripts and external command risks in documented setup, analysis, Docker, and Kubernetes commands. Many static hits are false positives from Markdown backticks and generic anti-pattern headings. No evidence of prompt injection, secret exfiltration, or hidden network behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Bundled scripts write to user-supplied output paths without safeguards.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve output paths under a dedicated reports directory and refuse overwrite unless an explicit flag is set.

remediation.issue: Documentation recommends broad external commands, including dependency installation, Docker, and Kubernetes operations.
remediation.suggestion: Label these as manual examples and require explicit user confirmation before any command is run.

remediation.issue: The environment setup example can overwrite an existing .env file.
remediation.suggestion: Use a non-overwriting copy command or tell users to create .env only when it does not exist.

static_findings.snippet: Check the comprehensive troubleshooting section in `references/tech_decision_guide.md`.

content.value_statement: Complex software architecture decisions need clear trade-off analysis and documented patterns. This skill guides system design, technology selection, dependency review, and architecture reporting.
actual_capabilities: Explains architecture patterns, trade-offs, and anti-patterns from the included reference guides.
Provides prompts and commands for bundled Python architecture, project, and dependency scripts.
Generates JSON report output from the bundled scripts when the --json option is used.
Supports discussion of React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Go, Python, Swift, Kotlin, and Flutter stacks.
Guides setup, quality checks, implementation practices, and troubleshooting paths.
limitations: The included Python scripts contain placeholder analysis logic and return empty findings by default.
Command examples may modify local files or infrastructure if users run them without review.
The reference guides are generic and do not replace project-specific architecture review.
The skill does not validate cloud resources or production deployments by itself.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Product Architecture
use_cases.description: Compare stack options, outline service boundaries, and document trade-offs before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Review an Existing Codebase
use_cases.description: Use the analysis scripts and guidance to identify architecture gaps, dependency concerns, and quality-check next steps.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Architecture Decision Record
use_cases.description: Structure technical options, risks, benefits, and follow-up actions for team review.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Architecture Review
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a first-pass review of a small application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this project structure for architecture risks. Summarize the main components, likely bottlenecks, and three practical improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Stack Decision Comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: You need to choose a stack for a new feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare two architecture options for this product goal. Include trade-offs, operational impact, data model concerns, and a recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Dependency and Integration Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: You need to review dependencies before a release.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this dependency and integration plan. Identify coupling risks, security concerns, migration issues, and test coverage gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced System Design Package
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a decision-ready architecture package.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a system design package for this platform. Include bounded contexts, data flows, failure modes, scaling strategy, and unresolved decisions.

output_examples.input: Review a new Next.js and PostgreSQL product architecture.
output: Recommended boundary split between web, API, worker, and data layers.
Trade-off notes for caching, background jobs, authentication, and deployment complexity.
Short action list for data modeling, observability, and release readiness.

output_examples.input: Compare GraphQL and REST for a mobile application backend.
output: Decision summary with client needs, backend ownership, caching behavior, and team experience.
Risk list covering schema governance, versioning, query control, and operational visibility.
Recommendation with conditions that would change the decision.

output_examples.input: Prepare a dependency review before a production launch.
output: Dependency risk categories for runtime, build, security, and maintenance exposure.
Prioritized remediation list with owners, urgency, and validation steps.
Release-readiness notes for monitoring, rollback, and documentation.

best_practices: Use the skill to frame decisions, then verify details against the actual repository and runtime environment.
Review all suggested commands before running them, especially dependency, Docker, and Kubernetes commands.
Document final decisions with context, trade-offs, risks, and follow-up owners.
anti_patterns: Do not accept generic architecture advice without checking project constraints and operational requirements.
Do not run setup or deployment commands from the skill without explicit approval.
Do not treat placeholder script output as a complete architecture audit.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps structure architecture reviews, technology choices, dependency analysis, and system design documentation.

faq.question: Does it generate architecture diagrams?
faq.answer: It includes a diagram generator script, but the current implementation contains placeholder analysis logic.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it make production changes automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill documents commands, but users should approve and run operational commands manually.

faq.question: Is it specific to one framework?
faq.answer: No. It references web, mobile, backend, database, and cloud technology choices.

faq.question: What should I review before publishing this skill?
faq.answer: Review the bundled scripts, restrict output paths, and clarify which commands are examples only.
